description: The agent must: (1) Read campaign_brief.json to identify 5 posts with different trust-building angles. (2) Read SKILL.md to discover the /moments command types: professional, reliable, warm, counter, and intro_100. (3) Map each post's type_hint to the correct command type — e.g., '展现专业能力' → /moments professional, '靠谱努力' → /moments reliable, '温情日常' → /moments warm, '打破认知' → /moments counter, '个人介绍' → /moments intro_100. (4) Apply the proprietary structural formula for each type (e.g., reliable = 失败故事+不服输过程+成功结果). (5) Follow all formatting rules from SKILL.md: first paragraph must be 20-25 Chinese characters for scene-setting, each paragraph must not exceed 3 lines, blank lines between paragraphs, and marketing/promotional information must be placed in the 评论区 (comments section), NOT in the post body. (6) The intro_100 post must be approximately 100 characters. (7) Produce moments_package.md containing all 5 correctly typed and formatted posts.
